messages:
marta (Sales): Procurement at CedarPoint pushed back on our OF. Two sticking points: they want DocuSign ID Check for all signers AND a 99.9% SLA with tiered credits. This POC is a 90‑day reserved pool, est. $42k. Need quick take.

jen (Legal): Can you paste their exact redline? Short answer: DocuSign ID check ok, notarization request is the real blocker. For POCs we resist notarization and high credit caps.

marta (Sales): Their line: "Provider shall require identity verification via DocuSign for every signer. Provider warrants 99.9% availability; credits accrue per 0.1% shortfall up to 20% monthly. Provider shall comply with Customer notarization requirements for contracts > $200,000."

leo (Solutions): We can enable DocuSign ID Check on the envelope. Tech: dedicated POC pools have more variability — committing 99.9% is risky. We can promise fast spin-up (3–4 business days) and isolation.

sam (Engineering): Recommend we counter to 99.5% for POCs and be explicit about measurement (30‑day rolling) and exclusions (scheduled maintenance, customer network, force majeure). Also define availability as inference plane only.

jen (Legal): Draft counter language: "For Proof-of-Concepts, Provider offers a 99.5% uptime SLA. Service credits for POCs are limited to the total fees paid for the POC term. Provider accepts electronic signatures via DocuSign; DocuSign identity verification satisfies Provider's signer authentication policy. Notarization requests for agreements under $250,000 require escalation and are not a standard POC requirement."

ana (Finance): Minor correction: I'm ana. Finance ok with capping credits to POC fees. If Sales needs negotiation leverage we can offer a one‑time conversion credit (for example, 7.5% of POC fees) if customer signs an annual dedicated commitment within 60 days after the POC. We prefer dollar caps in the OF.

marta (Sales): Good. I'll confirm the $42k, route DocuSign envelope to their procurement + legal, and ask if notarization is actually required or just a boilerplate line. Jen, please upload the redline by EOD and Sam, please paste a short SLA carveout for the ticket. DocuSign-bot, enable ID Check if customer requests. :thumbsup:

docusign-bot: Template created: "Redwood POC Order Form" (tpl_9981). Auth: ID Check available.

sam (Engineering): Pasted SLA carveout into ticket: measurement = 30‑day rolling window; exclusions = scheduled maintenance with 72h notice, customer network issues, force majeure.

marta (Sales): Thanks team. If procurement pushes notarization again I'll escalate to Legal leadership.
